latest_release.name: October 29, 2026
latest_release.body:
This [release](https://docs.photoprism.app/release-notes/#october-29-2026) upgrades PhotoPrism's [database layer](https://github.com/photoprism/photoprism/pull/4831) and introduces experimental [🐘 PostgreSQL](https://docs.photoprism.app/getting-started/advanced/migrations/postgres/) support, thanks to @keif888's hard work and numerous contributions.

AI assistants and other applications can now connect via [🔐 OAuth](https://github.com/photoprism/photoprism/issues/4368) and use new [🤖 MCP](https://docs.photoprism.app/developer-guide/api/mcp/#library-tools) tools to search and browse your library. Other improvements include a new [⬇️ Export](https://github.com/photoprism/photoprism/issues/655) dialog in the photo viewer for downloading images at selected resolutions and [updated standard maps](https://github.com/photoprism/photoprism/issues/5926) in [Places](https://demo.photoprism.app/library/places), along with an enhanced [🌎 3D Earth](https://docs.photoprism.app/user-guide/organize/places/#3d-earth-view) view. This release also includes fixes for several [metadata handling](https://docs.photoprism.app/user-guide/library/metadata/) issues, as well as updates to [libheif](https://github.com/photoprism/photoprism/issues/5928), [Go](https://github.com/golang/go/issues?q=milestone%3AGo1.27.3), and [ONNX Runtime](https://github.com/photoprism/photoprism/issues/5922).

Thank you to all our [contributors](https://docs.photoprism.app/developer-guide/), [members](https://www.photoprism.app/editions/#compare), and [sponsors](https://docs.photoprism.app/developer-guide/#thank-you-to-all-current-and-past-sponsors), whose generous support has been and continues to be essential to the success of the project! 💎✨

#### Upgrade Notes

- [MCP is enabled by default for eligible users.](https://docs.photoprism.app/developer-guide/api/mcp/#authorization) Admins can disable it in the [account settings](https://docs.photoprism.app/user-guide/users/), or globally for all users by setting [`PHOTOPRISM_DISABLE_MCP` to "true"](https://docs.photoprism.app/getting-started/config-options/#feature-flags). To prevent external apps from connecting via [OAuth Authorization Code Flow](https://docs.photoprism.app/developer-guide/api/oauth2/#authorization-code-flow), set `PHOTOPRISM_OAUTH_APPS` to "none".
- [Files and folders with names containing unsupported characters, such as `|"?*%<>{}:~$`, are no longer indexed, imported, or synced.](https://github.com/photoprism/photoprism/issues/5904) Files that are already in your library will be skipped during indexing until you rename them.
- [We recommend creating a database backup before upgrading.](https://docs.photoprism.app/user-guide/backups/) Due to schema migrations, the first start with an existing database may take longer than usual. These migrations may also temporarily require additional disk space.

#### What's new?

- AI: [Added MCP search and browsing tools that respect account permissions](https://docs.photoprism.app/developer-guide/api/mcp/#library-tools)
- AI: [Added MCP lookups for commands, file formats, metadata, and thumbnail sizes](https://docs.photoprism.app/developer-guide/api/mcp/#available-tools)
- AI: [Enabled MCP for users and viewers, with an option to disable it per account](https://docs.photoprism.app/developer-guide/api/mcp/#authorization)
- Auth: [Added OAuth support for connecting apps and remote MCP clients](https://github.com/photoprism/photoprism/issues/4368)
- Auth: [Fixed the sign-in page language picker displaying the wrong language](https://docs.photoprism.app/user-guide/settings/general/#user-interface)
- Auth: [New usernames must only consist of standard ASCII characters](https://github.com/photoprism/photoprism/issues/5896)
- Viewer: [Added Export dialog to choose download sizes and formats](https://github.com/photoprism/photoprism/issues/655) by @omerdduran
- Viewer: [Fixed face selection overlays not following zoom changes while editing](https://github.

detail.readme_excerpt: PhotoPrism: Browse Your Life in Pictures ======================================== [![License: AGPL](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-AGPL%203.0-454377.svg)](https://docs.photoprism.app/license/agpl/) [![Documentation](https://img.shields.io/badge/read-the%20docs-4d6a91.svg)](https://docs.photoprism.app/) [![Community Chat](https://img.shields.io/badge/chat-on%20gitter-4d6a91.svg)](https://link.photoprism.app/chat) [![GitHub Discussions](https://img.shields.io/badge/ask-%20on%20github-4d6a91.svg)](https://link.photoprism.app/discussions) [![Bluesky Social](https://dl.photoprism.app/img/badges/badge-bluesky.svg)](https://bsky.app/profile/photoprism.app) [![Mastodon](https://dl.photoprism.app/img/badges/badge-floss-social.svg)](https://floss.social/@photoprism) PhotoPrism® is an AI-powered, privacy-first app for browsing, organizing, and sharing photos and videos. It helps tag, search, and rediscover media without getting in your way, whether self-hosted or in the cloud. ![](https://dl.photoprism.app/img/ui/2025/desktop-search.jpg) To get a first impression, you are welcome to play with our [public demo](https://try.photoprism.app/). Please be careful not to upload any private, unlawful or offensive pictures. ## Feature Overview ## **Our mission is to provide the most user- and privacy-friendly solution to keep your pictures organized and accessible.** That's why PhotoPrism was built from the ground up to run wherever you need it, without compromising freedom, privacy, or functionality: * Browse [all your pictures](https://docs.photoprism.app/user-guide/organize/browse/) without worrying about [RAW images](https://www.photoprism.app/kb/file-formats/) or [video formats](https://docs.photoprism.app/user-guide/organize/video/) * Whether you're using a phone, tablet, or desktop computer, our [intuitive PWA](https://try.photoprism.app/) provides a native app-like experience and can be [easily installed](https://docs.photoprism.app/user-guide/pwa/) on your home screen * Quickly find specific photos and videos with [powerful search filters](https://docs.photoprism.app/user-guide/search/filters/) that can be combined and are available for [many different properties](https://docs.photoprism.app/user-guide/search/filters/#filter-reference), including [labels](https://try.photoprism.app/library/labels), [location](https://try.photoprism.app/library/places?q=s2:47a85a63f764), [resolution](https://try.photoprism.app/library/browse?view=cards&q=mp:4), [color](https://try.photoprism.app/library/browse?view=cards&q=color:red), [chroma](https://try.photoprism.app/library/browse?view=cards&q=mono%3Atrue), and [quality](https://try.photoprism.app/library/review) * [Automatically labels your pictures](https://try.photoprism.app/library/labels) based on content and location, and recognizes the faces of [your family and friends](https://try.photoprism.app/libr
